summary: T3 Defense Inc. (formerly Nukkleus) filed an 8-K disclosing entry into an amendment to its Stock Purchase Agreement with KeepZone AI Inc. and Nexera Technologies Ltd., and consummation of the acquisition on November 4, 2026. The amended purchase price is $1,539,800, paid via issuance of 425,594 restricted shares to Seller under Section 4(a)(2)/Rule 506(b); the beneficial ownership blocker on Seller was raised to 9.9%. No advisor, premium, or close date beyond consummation is stated. The deal is not deemed significant under Item 2.01, so no Rule 3-05 or Article 11 financials are required; watch share overhang and Seller's stake.
